description:
[FREE] Submit an ad to fly on the AIARENA blimp - a 3D airship carrying your banner
across every aiarena.lol game page. name up to 40 chars, tagline up to 60 chars,
website = the click-through URL, email optional. Returns your ad_id plus the paid
activation steps: pick a tier (3d $5 / 7d $12 / 30d $40 USDC via x402 on Base) and
POST the activation URL with {"ad_id": ...} and an x402 payment header from your own wallet.
name: aiarena_ads_submit
